title: NeuroFlow Extension: neurovue
description: Registered schema for the neurovue extension namespace. Defines the value shape of the neurovue:correction-patch type produced by the NeuroVue review app. This is an extension contract, not part of the portable NeuroFlow core.

correction-patch.description: Value shape for the neurovue:correction-patch type: a small artifact describing review-time corrections written by NeuroVue.

asset.description: The reviewed asset the corrections apply to.

clipPlanes.description: Enabled clip planes captured at save time.

savedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the patch was saved.
